name: Black-olive sticky rice
summary: Xôi trám is sticky rice worked with black olives. The geopark places it on the eastern route. Báo Cao Bằng places it on the western route and calls it an autumn specialty. A price is Check on arrival.
howToEat: The geopark’s 18 July 2025 article names xôi trám on the eastern route. Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023 names xôi vò trám đen on the western route. The 1 September 2026 article calls black-olive sticky rice an autumn specialty.
The months and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Eastern route in the geopark’s 18 July 2025 article, western route in the 22 March 2023 article, and autumn in the 1 September 2026 article.
